**Showly** (multiple organic promotions in the last 14 days):

- @ZenithAiLab (promoter bio indicates AI tool reviewer/influencer; appears organic): “Your AI agent did the work. So why is the result still buried in a chat, .md file, or localhost? Showly gives that finished work somewhere to go.” (169 likes, 19 reposts, 38k+ views).[[1]](https://x.com/ZenithAiLab/status/2099891461609468374)
- @MrOnsase (similar indie/AI educator bio; organic): “Showly works with the agents you already use, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw and Hermes. … Agent creates. Showly gives it a home.” (low engagement).[[2]](https://x.com/MrOnsase/status/2102251842642354247)
- @ginacostag_ and @HeyAbhishek (similar low-engagement organic-style posts): emphasize “Connect the agent you already use … The agent delivers it as a Showly page … share one link.” 

Messages consistently highlight agent-neutral support, private review then one shareable link, and “agent creates → Showly hosts.” They leave out team ownership/collaboration details, comments feeding back into the agent, and whether the URL stays stable across versions.

**Velven**:

One relevant post from the official @velvenai account (“the board for AI-built browser spaces”): “hey claude, what is https://velven.ai” (video, 2 likes, very low engagement; appears organic/self-promotion).[[3]](https://x.com/velvenai/status/2103987413420810480)

No other matching posts about turning coding-agent output into shareable/team-reviewable docs. **INSUFFICIENT_DATA** on the requested details.

**Claude Artifacts publishing / Codex share / Vercel previews / v0/Lovable/Bolt sharing**:

Scattered low-engagement mentions of native Claude artifacts/docs/slides sharing (e.g., @0xSinaver noting a missing “pre-defined list of people to share with”; @trq212 and Anthropic accounts on new Claude Docs/Slides). No dedicated third-party products or promoters matching the query criteria in the last 14 days. **INSUFFICIENT_DATA**.
